newsitem.title: USA: Weyerhaeuser says sale to affect Q3.
newsitem.headline: Weyerhaeuser says sale to affect Q3.

text.p: Weyerhaeuser Co said it closed the sale of Saskatoon Chemicals Ltd to a unit of Sterling Chemicals Holdings Inc for $65 million.
Weyerhaeuser said it expects the gain on the sale to have a material effect on its third quarter earnings.
Weyerhaeuser is due to announce its second quarter results next week. The consensus estimate for the second quarter earnings is $0.32 per share versus $0.52 per share.
For last year's third quarter, Weyerhaueser reported earnings of $0.60 a share. Weyerhaeuser said the sale is part of a continuing effort to focus on core businesses.
Located in Saskatchewan, Saskatoon Chemicals employs 165 and manufactures sodium chlorate, primarily for the pulp and paper industry, and water treatment and other chemicals.
Weyerhaeuser's pulp mills in Prince Albert and Kamloops will continue to purchase about 50 percent of the products manufactured by Saskatoon Chemicals.
